title: Discovery of a Novel and Potent LCK Inhibitor for Leukemia Treatment via Deep Learning and Molecular Docking
summary: Discovery of a Novel and Potent LCK Inhibitor for Leukemia Treatment via Deep Learning and Molecular Docking. The PLANET model combined with Schrodinger docking screened for LCK inhibitors. Four candidates identified; the lead had IC50 0.43 nM, antiproliferative effects in T-ALL cells and efficacy in a human T-ALL xenograft. Evidence limits: Selectivity and AI-versus-conventional baseline contribution not assessed (abstract only). Reviewed from Europe PMC abstract only.
